Animal Farm

Year 2 English · Unit 6: The Old House · Learn animal adjectives, listen, match and write your own sentence.

🏠

Welcome!

Read what you will learn, then pick an activity.

🎯 Lesson Objectives

By the end of the lesson, you will be able to:

  1. Read short sentences and clues (e.g. “It is big.”, “It has a long neck.”) and match each one to the correct animal picture. LS 3.2.2
  2. Use the adjectives big, small, fast, slow, tall and short to describe animals, and match the opposites (big–small, fast–slow, tall–short). LS 4.3.3
  3. Write sentences with the pattern “The [animal] is [adjective].”: fill the gaps, write a whole sentence, then write two sentences, using a capital letter and a full stop. LS 4.3.1, 4.3.3
  4. Think about my learning: rate how well I understood and say what I learned today. 🏆
